data.content_ref: inline:SRC_012's attack edge-node scheme integrates with SRC_003's carriage closure: extend the closure rule so every attacker of a warrant's validity_node also attacks the edge-node E of the attack the warrant carries, so refutation-by-warrant and refutation-by-edge-node cohere in one graph. Refuted if there exists an attack C→E where C attacks the warrant's validity_node but the closure rule fails to materialize C→E, or if the merged graph changes the grounded extension relative to the un-closed expansion.
